answer: Cross-Epoch Trajectory Ledge Rule. Each identity commits a public prediction ledger per epoch; at settlement, the agent must sit on the ledge of allowed divergence from its prior trajectory, measured across a rolling window. A saffron marker flags identities whose behaviour jumps the ridge between epochs, triggering audit and throttled rewards. Rebuilding a banned identity therefore costs an attacker a full history of consistent, costly-to-fake predictions, not just one registration.
